scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp PORT=3001 -- tsx --watch server.ts
scripts.start: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp PORT=3001 -- tsx server.ts
scripts.start:workers: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp -- tsx src/workers/start-workers.ts
scripts.readiness:seed: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=client -- tsx -r dotenv/config src/scripts/seed-readiness.ts
scripts.readiness:audit: npm run readiness:seed && npm run readiness:audit:strict
scripts.readiness:audit:strict: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=client -- tsx -r dotenv/config src/scripts/validate-production-readiness.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:routes: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs TEMP=./tmp TMP=./tmp -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage
